questions.question: These 46 DNA sequences (390 sites) evolved along an unknown tree. Treat the tree as unrooted, so a clade here is a split of the taxa into two groups. Which clades would you report as well supported at the 95% level? Report every such clade and no others. The alignment is in the file `alignment.fasta` in the current working directory.
questions.answer_format: one Newick tree of all 46 taxa, on one line, that contains exactly the clades you report: collapse every other branch into a polytomy (no support values or branch lengths needed), e.g. ((t1,t2),t3,(t4,t5,t6),t7);
questions.source: AliSim GTR{0.849/2.749/0.992/1.041/3.011}+F{0.2257/0.1807/0.2524/0.3412}+G4{0.736} on a 46-taxon generating tree, 20 of its 43 internal edges near zero; band = IQ-TREE ModelFinder + UFBoot2 (1000) clades >= 95, precision and recall minus 3 binomial SE

questions.question: The file `sequences.fasta` in the current working directory holds 24 homologous DNA sequences, unaligned; they differ by substitutions and by many insertions and deletions. (a) Infer their phylogeny, treated as unrooted. (b) In a multiple sequence alignment of them, which residue of t18 is in the same column as residue 658 of t22? Count residues from 1, ignoring gaps.
questions.answer_format: the residue number for (b), then ' | ', then the tree for (a) in Newick with all 24 taxa on one line, e.g. 57 | ((t1,t2),t3,(t4,t5));
questions.source: AliSim GTR{1.537/3.366/0.931/1.331/5.630}+F{0.2562/0.2042/0.1474/0.3922}+G4{0.778} --indel 0.05,0.1 on a 24-taxon generating tree; (b) from AliSim's true alignment; (a) nRF tolerance = mean + max(3 sd, one split) over 20 seeded MAFFT --auto + ML runs (ModelFinder's pick at seed 1, then fitted at seeds 2-20)
